headline: President Biden signed an executive order on March 14, 2023, aimed at reducing gun violence and making communities safer.
what_it_does: This executive order focuses on reducing gun violence in the United States. Executive orders usually direct federal agencies to take certain actions. The specific steps are not described in the information provided.

who_it_affects.how: Executive orders usually tell federal agencies what to do, so agencies are likely to be directed to take steps related to gun violence, though the details are not given here.

when_it_takes_effect: 2023-03-14 (the date it was signed; executive orders usually take effect when signed)
